enforcementIntent.title: Hermes Agentic Loop Quality Gate Enforcement Intent
enforcementIntent.summary: Declare the bounded implementation intent for wiring quality gate enforcement into future Hermes agentic patch/apply and lifecycle scripts.
implementationScope: Create a reusable qualityGate object shape for future agentic run artifacts.
Require future source-patch-proposal artifacts to declare qualityGate applicability.
Require future source-patch-apply artifacts to include qualityGate status before readiness.
Require future source-patch-validation artifacts to fail closed when gate status is absent or failed.
Carry qualityGate status into PR draft, post-merge ledger, and run-index artifacts.
enforcementRules: Future patch/apply steps must fail closed when quality gate status is absent.
Patch apply reports must include applied, changed, diffOutput, and semanticChange.
Timestamp-only changes must be classified as noise unless explicitly justified.
Generated artifact drift must be committed as declared output or restored before clean-state claims.
Changed paths must be compared against declared targets before readiness.
Branch, push, PR creation, and merge remain operator-controlled.
The enforcement plan is not itself a source patch application.

enforcementPoints.requirement: Declare whether the proposed patch is subject to the loop-quality gate and list expected changed paths.
Run or reference the loop-quality gate before reporting ready-for-human-review.
Fail validation when gate status is missing, failed, or timestamp/no-op drift is unclassified.
Confirm generated drift is clean or intentionally declared before preparing a branch.
Include loop-quality gate status in PR draft metadata and validation section.
Record quality gate status with post-merge validation results.
Expose quality gate status as part of durable run-level state.

enforcementIntent.expectedNextStep: Generate v9.1 quality gate enforcement implementation artifact and gate; do not broadly rewrite workflow scripts yet.

notes: This declares the implementation intent for v9.1 quality gate enforcement.
It does not wire enforcement into future scripts yet.
The next safe step is v9.1 enforcement implementation.
